summary.text: Prince Chestnut is a Democratic state representative from Alabama House District 67 who took office in April 2017 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. Chestnut practices law in Selma and has served as a municipal judge.

paragraphs.text: Chestnut's professional experience includes serving as a municipal judge and practicing law in Selma, Alabama.
He assumed office in the Alabama House on April 25, 2017.

In the 2025-2026 session Chestnut was assigned to the House Judiciary Committee, the State Government Committee, the Urban and Rural Development Committee, the Ways and Means Education Committee and the Joint Legislative Committee on State Parks.
